remarks: Originally designed with the hallmarks of mid-century modern architecture-open living spaces, soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and a connection to the outdoors-this private waterfront community home has been renovated for contemporary living while preserving its spirit. The primary suite features two home offices, laundry, a steam shower, and a private wraparound deck. The main level offers an open floor plan, three additional bedrooms, three baths, and a hot tub. Bluestone terraces invite outdoor living. The lower level is a legal ADU with a private entrance. Annual HOA dues of $1,195 include access to a private beach, deep-water marina, boat slip, small-boat rack, tennis courts, dog park, playground, and more. The seller professionally designed and built the home and gardens and has maintained them for over 40 years. Mature plantings provide privacy. Garden shed with electricity and water. Some photos are virtually edited.
